title: Breath and smoke stay a small part of the first-person frame
note: Bright puff pixels cover at most a tenth of the first-person frame during the breath effect, else it is a blob, not breath.
intent: The pixel side of the breath effect: whatever the sprites measure in world units, what matters is how much of the frame they whiten. Keep the bright fraction of the first-person frame under about a tenth by spawning few particles (five to ten per breath), keeping them small and low-opacity, and letting them drift away from the camera rather than across it. If the effect still washes the frame, the emitter is too close to the near plane — move it forward, do not lower the opacity until it disappears.

check.note: Captured during the breath/smoke effect from the first-person default camera: bright puff pixels cover at most ~10% of the frame, else it is a blob, not breath.

port: The effects facet captures the default first-person camera during the breath and reads the frame before tuning anything.
